muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿والعاديات﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, and «العاديات» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb of oath.
﴿ضبحا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa, because «الضبح» is a kind of travelling and running. Or: a mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative by the fatḥa, of an omitted verb, i.e. «يضبحن ضبحا» ("panting a panting"), and the implied clause ﴿يضبحن ضبحا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العاديات». Or ﴿ضبحًا﴾ is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. "panting" (ضابحاتٍ), or "possessed of panting" (ذوي ضَبْح). «الضبح» is a sound heard from the chests of horses when running. The oath clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿فالموريات﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «الموريات» is conjoined to ﴿العاديات﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿قدحا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa. Or: a mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative by the fatḥa, of an omitted verb, i.e. «يقدحن قدحا» ("striking sparks a striking"), and the implied clause ﴿يقدحن قدحا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الموريات». Or ﴿قدحًا﴾ is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. "striking sparks" (قادحاتٍ).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿فالمغيرات﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «المغيرات» is conjoined to ﴿الموريات﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿صبحا﴾: an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿المغيرات﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿فأثرن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أثرن» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the nūn is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿به﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the kasra in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أثرن﴾, and the pronoun in ﴿به﴾ refers back to the morning, or to the place of the raid, or to the running.
﴿نقعا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the clause ﴿أثرن﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the active participle before it, because that participle is interpreted as a verb, since it occurs as the ṣila of ﴿أل﴾, i.e. ﴿واللاتي عدون فأورين فأغرن فأثرن﴾ ("by those that ran, then struck sparks, then raided, then raised").

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فوسطن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «وسطن» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the nūn is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿به﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the kasra in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وسطن﴾. The pronoun in ﴿به﴾ refers back to the morning, so the bāʾ is adverbial (ẓarfiyya); or to the dust, so the bāʾ is for transitivity, i.e. "they placed the dust (النقع), which is the «الغبار», in the midst of the host"; or the bāʾ is circumstantial, i.e. "they penetrated into the midst, enveloped in dust", so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of ﴿فوسطن﴾.
﴿جمعا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the clause ﴿وسطن﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أثرن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿الإنسان﴾: the noun (ism) of «إن», accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿لربه﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «رب» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; «رب» is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the kasra in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كنود﴾.
﴿لكنود﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «كنود» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of the oath.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إن» is an abrogating particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of «إن».
﴿على ذلك﴾: «على» is a preposition, and «ذا» is a demonstrative indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of genitive; the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شهيد﴾.
﴿لشهيد﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «شهيد» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma. The clause ﴿إنه على ذلك...﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the preceding clause that answers the oath.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إن» is an abrogating particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of «إن».
﴿لحب﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «حب» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شديد﴾, and «حب» is muḍāf.
﴿الخير﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra.
﴿لشديد﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «شديد» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause ﴿وإنه لحب الخير...﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause answering the oath ﴿إن الإنسان...﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿أفلا يعلم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī), a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa with no grammatical position; the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e. "does he do the vile things he does, and does he not know?" (أيفعل ما يفعل من القبائح فلا يعلم); «لا» is negating; and «يعلم» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to man; the object of «يعلم» is omitted, i.e. "does he not know that We will requite him?" (أفلا يعلم أنا نجازيه).
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb of future time stripped of the sense of condition, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied object of «يعلم», i.e. "does he not know that We will requite him when what is in the graves is scattered..." (أفلا يعلم أنا نجازيه إذا بعثر...إلخ).
﴿بعثر﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and it is passive (lit. "whose agent is not named").
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «بعثر».
﴿في القبور﴾: «في» is a preposition, and «القبور» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by «في», the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿بعثر ما في القبور﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being annexed to it.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وحصل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «حُصِّلَ» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and it is passive (lit. "whose agent is not named").
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «حصِّل».
﴿في الصدور﴾: «في» is a preposition, and «الصدور» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by «في», the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿حصل ما في الصدور﴾ is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ﴿بعثر ما في القبور﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿ربهم﴾: the noun (ism) of «إن», accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; «رب» is muḍāf, the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿بهم﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the kasra in the position of genitive, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خبير﴾.
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time, accusative by the fatḥa, attached to ﴿خبير﴾, and it is muḍāf; «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable on the sukūn, implied because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, i.e. "on the day when what is in the graves is scattered and what is in the breasts is brought out" (يوم إذ يُبعثَر ما في القبور ويُحَصَّل ما في الصدور).
﴿لخبير﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «خبير» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause gives the reason for the omitted object of ﴿يعلم﴾, with no grammatical position.
